quantra_FxForwardResponse.description:
FX forward pricing result. With S the spot rate, t_s the spot date, T the
adjusted maturity, N the base notional, K the contract rate, sign = +1 for
BuyBase / -1 for SellBase, and DF_b / DF_q the two discount curves:
base_leg_pv  = sign * N * DF_b(T)              (base currency)
quote_leg_pv = -sign * N * K * DF_q(T)         (quote currency)
X            = S * DF_q(t_s) / DF_b(t_s)       (as-of exchange rate, quote per base)
npv          = base_leg_pv * X + quote_leg_pv  (reporting = quote currency)
= base_leg_pv + quote_leg_pv / X  (reporting = base currency)
fair_forward_rate = X * DF_b(T) / DF_q(T)
= S * [DF_b(T)/DF_b(t_s)] / [DF_q(T)/DF_q(t_s)]
Repricing the forward at K = fair_forward_rate gives npv = 0. Every value is
as of the evaluation date (the curves' reference date), like the NPV of
every other product.

npv.description:
Present value in `reporting_currency`, positive in favour of the party
whose `direction` was given.

fair_forward_rate.description:
Fair (zero-NPV) forward rate for the adjusted maturity, quote units per
base unit.

forward_points.description:
`fair_forward_rate - spot`, in price units of the pair (the forward
points at this maturity, as an FX swap screen quotes them).

base_leg_pv.description:
Present value of the base-currency cash flow, in base currency
(positive when the reported party receives it).

quote_leg_pv.description:
Present value of the quote-currency cash flow, in quote currency
(negative when the reported party pays it).

spot_date.description:
Spot date used: the (adjusted) evaluation date advanced `spot_days`
business days on the spot's joint settlement calendar, ISO.

maturity_date.description:
Maturity date after adjustment with the spot's calendar and
business-day convention, ISO. The cash flows are discounted to it.

fx_spot_used.description:
The spot rate the forward was priced with (quote units per base unit,
for delivery on `spot_date`), resolved from `pricing.fx.spots` or the
referenced Fx quote.

quantra_PriceFxForwardResponse.description: Response wrapper for multiple FX forwards, in request order.
